caption: The drawing is a technical line illustration rendered in black ink on a beige background, depicting a piece of furniture that combines a table with a cabinet above it on the left side. The cabinet is rectangular with classical moldings and two vertical panels on its front, supported by two fluted legs with small bases and decorated capitals. The table underneath the cabinet features a rectangular top with a similarly paneled apron and is supported by two fluted legs on the right, which are topped with sculpted heads at the upper part of the legs. Both the table and cabinet display symmetrical, classical architectural details such as fluting, capitals, and pedestals. The scale "1 ½ in per 1 ft" is indicated near the upper right corner. The entire drawing is enclosed within a double-line border, with the right side of the composition left empty.
